senses.gloss: m. (v. שׁוּף II) paste, a small board on the hunter’s rod smeared over with glue.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:4">Sabb. VIII, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Shabbat 78b:2">78ᵇ</cite>) <he>דבק כדי ליתן בראש הש׳</he> Bab. ed. (Mish. a. Y. ed. <he>השַׁבְשֶׁבֶת</he>); expl. ib. 80ᵃ <he>כדי ליתן בראש ש׳ שבראש קנה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. a. O. <cite ref="U00193"><he>שבשבת</he></cite>; Alf. Ms. <cite ref="U01811"><he>שַׁפְשֶׁפֶת</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3) as much glue as is required to put on the top of the ‘paste board’ which is on the fowlers’ reed.
